confirmatory_window.note: No confirmatory-window candle has been read. The v2 confirmatory window starts after the v2 candidate freeze and needs at least 2160 closed hourly candles, so it cannot be evaluated in this session. The v1 holdout is never reused.

data_source.endpoint_policy: same-provider failover; selected endpoint recorded per asset

hashing.note: manifest_hash is the sha256 of the manifest body with manifest_hash and snapshot_identity.data_manifest_hash removed, so that the manifest can carry the data-manifest hash without hashing itself into a cycle.

notes: v2 data manifest. Every accepted asset references an immutable canonical hourly CSV dataset under research/data/candles_v2. Synthetic records are never permitted. Nothing here is a research result: no grid, backtest or candidate selection has been run under v2.

prerequisite_status.note: configs/research_v2.json is immutable and still records P2 and P3 as OUTSTANDING; that statement describes the specification's own scope at freeze time and is not rewritten here. Flipping it requires a versioned amendment to the specification.

window_policy.note: The candle window ends at the last fully closed hour at the snapshot retrieval timestamp, so the dataset is bound to the same snapshot as the universe and re-running the validation reproduces byte-identical datasets.
